The report indicates that demand continues to exceed supply due to rising fuel prices.

The company’s high market price suggests optimism for future innovations in AI, like Robotaxis and Optimus. New shareholders face challenges compared to those who invested early.

articles.title: ‘Loser’ Elon Musk Lost $80 Bn In An Afternoon: Is He On The Democrat ‘Hitlist’ Now?
articles.description: Elon Musk lost $80 billion in a single afternoon as Wall Street crashed after the US midterms, pushing his net worth below $800 billion. Days earlier, he had spent a record of nearly half a billion dollars trying to help Republicans win. They lost. Now Democrats control Congress and are eyeing probes into DOGE, his government contracts and Starlink. Is the world’s richest man in real trouble, or are these just paper losses? Meghna Deka decodes if Musk is on the Democrat ‘hitlist’.

articles.title: MoD's stop-work shocker for building projects close to defence sites in Mumbai
articles.description: The Defence ministry has issued an immediate halt to construction projects near defence establishments without necessary approvals. This decision affects numerous ongoing developments, especially in suburban areas close to ordnance depots. Many projects in Malad-Kandivli are currently under various stages of construction and could be stalled. Developers and homebuyers are facing deepening uncertainty due to this sudden change. The halt could significantly impact the real estate sector in Mumbai.
